_readme: border = 9-slice border in PNG pixels {l, r, t, b}. Unity Sprite.border / TextureImporter.spriteBorder is a Vector4 (left, bottom, right, top): spriteBorderVector4 gives it in that order. borderRef / outsetRef / logicalRef = 1920x1080 reference px. outsetRef = how far the sprite reaches past its RectTransform (Background: anchors stretch, offsetMin = (-l, -b), offsetMax = (r, t)).

panel_wood.note: Wood panel r14, cobalt band + rim baked. Pills, tracker, inspector, action bar, menu buttons (normal).

panel_wood_enemy.note: Same, band in team.enemy: the enemy inspector card.

pill_wood.note: Fully round ends at 56 high (HP / energy pills, name plate). Height 48-64 keeps the ends round enough; for other heights scale the sprite.

window_frame.note: Large wood plaque r22 with the inner bevel line at 12 px: Welcome plaque, Settings / Codex / Pause windows.

dialogue_box.note: Visual-novel dialogue box (~1100x220), a shade darker than panels so the cream text reads over any scene. Name plate = pill_wood.

paper_card.note: Paper card r12 with a paper-edge band: generic readable card (rewards, codex entries).

tooltip_paper.note: Tooltip box r14 (340-380 wide, pad 16-18). Add a tail sprite for the pointing version.

paper_stat.note: Small paper tile r10 (inspector stats 48 high, chips on paper).

tooltip_tail_down.note: Tail for a tooltip ABOVE its anchor. Pivot (0.5, 1) at the anchor; its top 12 px overlap the box bottom (covers the edge band).

tooltip_tail_up.note: Tail for a tooltip BELOW its anchor (rotate the same sprite or use this one). Top 4 px overlap the box.

shadow_soft.note: Soft drop shadow under any panel/button (the mockups' 0 18px 28px). Sibling before the Background, offset y -10, alpha 0.5-0.8.

field_paper_error.note: Invalid (empty name): bad ring + help text in bad says why.

btn_primary_pressed.note: Face sits 4 px lower (band 6 -> 2): move Label/Icon down 4 px with it.

btn_secondary_pressed.note: Face sits 4 px lower (band 6 -> 2): move Label/Icon down 4 px with it.

btn_danger_pressed.note: Face sits 4 px lower (band 6 -> 2): move Label/Icon down 4 px with it.

menu_btn_primary_normal.note: Main menu Continue / Welcome Start (cobalt side).

menu_btn_primary_hover.note: Main menu Continue / Welcome Start (cobalt side).

menu_btn_primary_pressed.note: Main menu Continue / Welcome Start (cobalt side). Face 4 px lower: move Label/Icon with it.

menu_btn_primary_disabled.note: Main menu Continue / Welcome Start (cobalt side).

menu_btn_wood_normal.note: Main menu list buttons (dark wood side).

menu_btn_wood_hover.note: Main menu list buttons (dark wood side).

menu_btn_wood_pressed.note: Main menu list buttons (dark wood side). Face 4 px lower: move Label/Icon with it.

menu_btn_wood_disabled.note: Main menu list buttons (dark wood side).

menu_panel_r14.note: Small deep menu panel (optional, e.g. Victory / Defeat).

ibtn_normal.note: Icon button 56x56 (min 44): icon 24-28 centred, tooltip on hover.

focus_ring_r14.note: White, tint accent: 2 px gap + 3 px ring around the face and rim (menu_* deep sprites: stretch it 9 px lower). On top of the Background, raycast off.

focus_ring_pill.note: Same for pills and round buttons (logical 96x56 source; any width).

glow_r14.note: Soft glow (white, tint gold / accent) behind a control: attention pulse, aiming, ability ready.

endturn_normal.note: Your turn, actions left. Label "End turn" + key badge "Enter".

endturn_hover.note: Hover: lighter face + accent.light ring. Also shows next-turn ghost pips on the board (see spec).

endturn_enemy.note: Enemy turn: wood face, not interactable; label "Enemy turn" in cream.300.

endturn_attention.note: Nothing left to do: gold ring + glow. Pulse endturn_glow alpha on top of this.

endturn_glow.note: White glow ring (tint gold) behind the face; animate alpha 0.35-0.9, 1.6 s ping-pong.

badge_cost.note: Cost coin: dark wood pill, gold ring. Number Plinth 20 in gold. Min 48 wide; grows with digits.

badge_cost_poor.note: Can't afford: ring in bad, number in bad (not grey).

badge_key.note: Key badge (paper, ink text Plinth 18). Grows for "Enter", "Ctrl 1".

badge_key_dark.note: Key badge on paper backgrounds / tooltips (cream text).

badge_stack.note: Stack count on status icons (hidden at 1). cream.100 Plinth 18.

badge_circle_gold.note: Energy coin socket (bolt icon tinted ink).

badge_placed.note: Placed check on a hand card (top-right, replaces the key badge).

hpbar_fill.note: White with baked shading: tint hp.high / hp.mid / hp.low. Width = parent width x ratio (anchorMax.x); hide under 14 px.

hpbar_ghost.note: Flat white: tint hp.ghost 55 %; shrinks to the fill after 0.4 s.

chip_status.note: Status chip (neutral status): text status, Nunito Bold 20, number Plinth.

tag_phase_player.note: "Your turn" tag in the tracker. White Plinth 22.

portrait_ring.note: Inspector portrait 96: paper disc + cobalt ring. Portrait render goes in a child masked by mask_circle.

mask_circle.note: Mask sprite (Mask component, Show Mask Graphic off).

mask_r8.note: Rounded mask for card art wells.

hand_tray.note: Tray 168 tall at the bottom edge (bottom corners off-screen), flat wood + thin rim. Padding 0 22 14, gap 6.

nameplate_normal.note: Name plate 108x28: Nunito ExtraBold 18 cream.100, centred.

nameplate_poor.note: Can't afford: darker plate, name cream.300 (cost coin in bad, render 40 % grey).

nameplate_placed.note: Placed (tower is on the board, not selected): WOOD plate, cream name + onboard tag. Cobalt is reserved for the selected piece.

nameplate_selected.note: SELECTED piece (its tower is selected on the board): cobalt plate, white name.

nameplate_placed_hover.note: Placed + hover: wood + accent.light edge (its board ring lights up; click selects it).

piece_plinth_empty.note: Empty plinth of a placed tower (108x52 at the piece's bottom centre, 34 px above the slot bottom like the render's base). The colour portrait medallion (medallion_ring) stands on it.

medallion_ring.note: Placed piece: colour portrait medallion 64 standing on the empty plinth (top 26 in the slot). Paper disc + cobalt ring; the portrait is a child Image under a Mask (mask_circle 64), drawn on top of the disc, ring sprite again not needed.

medallion_ring_selected.note: Selected piece medallion: brighter cobalt ring + soft outer glow (same size as medallion_ring).

piece_selected_arrow.note: Small cobalt arrow above the selected piece, pointing up toward the board (bob 3 px, 1.2 s).

piece_shadow.note: Ground shadow under the render (centre 30 px above the slot bottom). Hover: scale 0.75, alpha 0.6; picked: scale 0.6, alpha 0.4.

piece_glow.note: Soft glow behind the render (tint gold, alpha 0.7) while picked; accent alpha 0.35 on hover is optional.

ability_ready.note: Ready: raised wood face. Icon 40 cream.100, key badge top-left (inside), cost badge bottom-right, clock ring around.

ability_hover.note: Hover: lifts 5 px (UIFeedback), accent.light edge; range preview on the board + tooltip above the bar.

ability_aiming.note: Aiming (waiting for a target): gold edge + glow, stays lifted. Right click / Esc cancels.

ability_cooldown.note: On cooldown: dark face, icon alpha 0.45 + saturation 40 % (tint), clock ring shows recovered segments, corner badge = turns left.

ability_held.note: Held cooldown (waits for a reset, e.g. a kill): gold-dark inner line, corner badge shows the lock, ring all dark; tooltip "Ready after a kill".

ability_blocked.note: Ready but cannot be used now (no target, energy, rooted): icon 40 %, faint bad line; click shakes + tooltip reason.

ability_overlay_ready.note: Full-face overlay, ready: thin rim + top highlight over the icon face.

ability_overlay_cooldown.note: Cooldown: 55 % dark veil (icon reads ~45 %); clock ring around + corner badge.

ability_overlay_held.note: Held: dark veil + gold-dark inner line; corner badge shows the lock.

ability_overlay_blocked.note: Blocked: veil + bad inner line; click shakes, tooltip says why.

clock_ring_1_ready.note: Cooldown 1: ready = all segments cobalt + glow.

clock_ring_2_ready.note: Cooldown 2: ready = all segments cobalt + glow.

clock_ring_3_ready.note: Cooldown 3: ready = all segments cobalt + glow.

clock_ring_fill.note: Alternative to the frames: white ring for Image Filled Radial360 (origin Top, clockwise), tinted; put clock_ring_gaps_N on top.

clock_ring_gaps_2.note: Rim-coloured segment gaps for a 2-turn cooldown (over clock_ring_fill).

clock_ring_gaps_3.note: Rim-coloured segment gaps for a 3-turn cooldown (over clock_ring_fill).

cd_badge.note: Corner badge (38, centre on the button's top-right corner, 12 px out): turns left, Plinth 22 cream.100. Held: lock icon 20 gold instead.

cd_badge_soon.note: "Ready next turn" (1 left): glow baked; pulse alpha between cd_badge and this over 1.1 s.

pip_ability_ready.note: Board pip (28) per ability: ready. Flash on refill (scale 1.45, 0.6 s).

pip_ability_wait.note: Waiting: turns left on it (Plinth 18 cream.100).

pip_ability_held.note: Held: lock icon 16 gold on it.

pip_ability_ghost.note: Preview while End turn is hovered: will be ready next turn.

pip_mini_ready.note: Mini pip 18 for a placed hand piece (same meaning as the board pips).

pip_mini_wait.note: Mini pip waiting: number Plinth 18 is too big for 18 px; show the number only on hover (tooltip), or no number.

ready_glow.note: Ground glow under a tower that can still act (>= 1 ready ability): flat quad on the tile, tint accent alpha 0.45, breathe 1.6 s.

cooldown_ring.note: Small radial clock (Filled Radial360) for round things: enemy intent chip "long cooldown", enemy card abilities.

badge_ready_pop.note: "Ready!" pop over a tower when an ability comes off cooldown at turn start. Text ink, Plinth 22.

decal_enemy_path.note: Tile decal (1 tile = 128 px texture): enemy path step. Quad on the tile top, unlit transparent.

decal_enemy_stop.note: Tile where the enemy stops: solid + inner glow.

decal_select_ring.note: Selected unit tile: cobalt ring decal (alternative to the yellow selection tile). Same blue as the selected hand piece.

decal_range.note: Ability range (the calmest decal): accent fill 30 % + ONE thin light-blue border (no dark outline: the double ring is reserved for selection), no pulse.

decal_area.note: Area / splash while aiming: diagonal hatch + strong accent.light border (pattern = area, not range).

decal_place.note: Free build tile while placing a tower: gold-cream corner brackets + faint gold fill.

decal_place_blocked.note: Build tile you cannot use (occupied, not affordable, blocked): red brackets + small x; tooltip says why.

decal_move.note: Tile a walk can reach: cream soft fill + dotted cream border (not blue = range, not green = heal).

decal_move_step.note: Route step marker (one per tile on the chosen path).

decal_move_dest.note: Destination: cream ring + chevron (points along the move; rotate the quad to the last step direction).

plate_full_backing.note: Board plate FULL state (hovered / selected unit): thin translucent dark backing behind the 164x8 bar + 32 px chips with badges (padding 6 8).

decal_target_valid.note: Valid target while aiming: pulse alpha 1 -> 0.55, 0.9 s.

decal_heal_valid.note: Valid ally target for heals / buffs (green), same pulse.

line_attack_dash.note: Dash 14 + gap 10 (one period, wrap Repeat). LineRenderer width 6-8 px equivalent, Texture Mode Tile, scroll offset -24 px / 0.6 s.

line_attack_end.note: Arc end dot on the target.

stripes_damage_preview.note: Predicted HP loss on a plate / HP bar: RawImage, uvRect.width = rect.width / 12, blink alpha 1 -> 0.45 over 0.7 s.

tag_kills.note: "Kills" / "Öldürür" tag 30 px above a plate when the preview is lethal. White Plinth 18.

intent_attack.note: Enemy intent: sword / castle icon 22 + damage (Plinth 20 cream.100). Castle (hits the base) pulses intent_glow.

intent_move.note: Enemy intent: move, back-arrow icon + tiles (← 2).

intent_wait.note: Enemy intent: waits (clock icon only, or cooldown_ring + turns for a long cooldown).

intent_glow.note: White glow behind an intent chip (tint fx.damage): "hits the base" threat pulse 1.2 s.

ribbon_enemy.note: Enemy action name ("Smash!") over the acting enemy: white Plinth 30 + 2 px black shadow; pop 1.1 s.

chip_unit_status.note: Status over a unit (always visible): icon 18 + stacks Plinth 18 cream. Neutral / control status.

atk_melee_chevron_enemy.note: Melee: short solid chevron on the edge between attacker and target tile (world quad, rotated to the direction).

atk_line_dash_enemy.note: Projectile: straight dashed LOW line (2 points, ~0.3 m above the tiles), stops at the first blocker. Repeat wrap, scroll 1 period / 0.6 s.

atk_lob_dots_enemy.note: Lobbed: dotted HIGH arc: LineRenderer with N = 16-24 points on a parabola (apex = 0.35 × distance), ignores blockers.

atk_beam_enemy.note: Beam: solid line (2 points, Stretch texture mode). Every unit on it gets its own damage preview.

atk_spell_link_enemy.note: Spell: no attack line; only this faint link (caster → target, alpha 0.45) plus the rune under the target.

atk_impact_ring_enemy.note: Lobbed: impact ring decal on the landing tile.

atk_splash_enemy.note: Splash area: one decal per tile in the area (dotted = area, not path).

atk_rune_enemy.note: Spell: rune decal under the target (slow spin 8 s / turn).

atk_melee_chevron_player.note: Melee: short solid chevron on the edge between attacker and target tile (world quad, rotated to the direction).

atk_line_dash_player.note: Projectile: straight dashed LOW line (2 points, ~0.3 m above the tiles), stops at the first blocker. Repeat wrap, scroll 1 period / 0.6 s.

atk_lob_dots_player.note: Lobbed: dotted HIGH arc: LineRenderer with N = 16-24 points on a parabola (apex = 0.35 × distance), ignores blockers.

atk_beam_player.note: Beam: solid line (2 points, Stretch texture mode). Every unit on it gets its own damage preview.

atk_spell_link_player.note: Spell: no attack line; only this faint link (caster → target, alpha 0.45) plus the rune under the target.

atk_impact_ring_player.note: Lobbed: impact ring decal on the landing tile.

atk_splash_player.note: Splash area: one decal per tile in the area (dotted = area, not path).

atk_rune_player.note: Spell: rune decal under the target (slow spin 8 s / turn).

atk_blocked_x.note: Blocked: screen-space marker where the shot stops (on the blocker). The blocker gets the damage preview; the aimed target is greyed (plate alpha 0.4, no stripes) with a chip "Blocked by Wall" (paper_stat, ink.2).

atk_redirect.note: Redirected (Bodyguard, Taunt): marker at the bend; the line goes from the original target to the new one, tooltip names the cause.

btn_wood_pressed.note: .k-btn.is-pressed: face 4 px lower; move the label with it.

row_normal.note: .k-row: min height 60, padding 6 16 6 8, gap 14, Nunito Bold 22 cream.100 (Codex list, level list).

row_locked.note: .k-row.is-locked: cream.300 text + lock_badge; tooltip / sub line says how to unlock.

toggle_off.note: .k-toggle (off): 76x40 with the knob left. Always with the word "Off" (Nunito ExtraBold 20 cream.200) 14 px to the right.

toggle_track_off.note: Track only (if the knob animates as its own Image).

toggle_knob.note: Knob 32; slides 36 px in 0.15 s ease.out.

dropdown_normal.note: .k-select: min 300x52, padding 0 12 0 18, Nunito Bold 22 ink, arrow = icon_next 24 tinted ink at the right.

dropdown_arrow.note: White chevron (tint ink); same as icon_next.

keyslot_listening.note: .k-slot.is-listening: "Press a key…" Nunito ExtraBold 20 white; Esc cancels, Backspace clears.

keyslot_conflict.note: .k-slot.is-conflict: bad.ink text + warning; the note row under it names the other action.

close_normal.note: .k-close 52x52 (x baked, cream + rim). Top-right of windows; Esc / right click do the same.

ibtn_flat_normal.note: .k-ibtn 52 (no band; put any icon on it).

dialogue_nameplate.note: .vn-box .vn-name: wood plate (blue = active only) overlapping the dialogue box top-left (left 36, top -30), padding 0 26, speaker name Plinth 28 teal + role Nunito ExtraBold 18 cream.300.

speaker_frame.note: Framed speaker portrait (codex / small dialogue). The big VN bust (~440x560) stands free without a frame.

loadbar_fill.note: .boot-bar i: inset 3 px in the track; width = progress.

codex_stage.note: .stage: paper stage behind the 3D model (the RenderTexture / camera view sits on top).

codex_plinth.note: .stage .plinth 240x64 (if the model has no base of its own).

chapter_header.note: .chap: header line under "Chapter 1" (Plinth 26 cream.200; count Nunito ExtraBold 18 cream.300 at the right).

new_dot.note: .k-new: dot 14 + the word "New" (Nunito ExtraBold 18 accent.light) - colour is never the only signal.

medal_ring.note: .k-medal: 48 portrait medal in list rows (portrait under mask_circle).

well.note: .k-well: sunken area inside a window (lists, pages).
